g1.label: 1. Where ___ from?
g1.why: With be, the verb comes before the subject: “Where are you from?”

g2.label: 2. What ___ at university?
g2.why: Present simple questions need do + subject + base verb.

g3.label: 3. How long ___ in Germany?
g3.why: “How long” up to now takes the present perfect: have + subject + past participle.

g4.label: 4. ___ English at work?
g4.why: A yes/no question in the present simple starts with Do + subject + base verb.

g5.label: 5. What ___ you to this course?
g5.why: “What” is the subject here, so there is no did: “What brought you…?”

g6.label: 6. Can you tell me what ___?
g6.why: Indirect questions keep statement word order: subject before verb.
